items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Bill Struthers; the interviewer mentions him as a disc jockey who thought he had recorded the interviewee, and the interviewee responds only to the interviewer's narrative.

ctx.x: And which that poor, dear man, Bill Struthers, thought he had recorded, Bill Struthers being a disc jockey on KPFK here, and it turned out that it wasn't recorded, which is another funny story. But do you feel that Duke believed where he was arguing from that night? Because Duke took the standpoint that --
That there was no place for emotion in music.
